We’re introducing Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime allowing agents to defend systems without downtime. It lets agents write dynamic eBPF controls to shield systems from exploits, giving defenders more time to test and roll out patches. Built by @cisco together with OpenAI.
items.title_zh: 我们推出 Shirudo，一个开源 Linux 运行时，让智能体能够在不造成停机的情况下防御系统。它允许智能体编写动态 eBPF 控制来保护系统免受漏洞利用，为防御者争取更多时间测试和推出补丁。由 @cisco 与 OpenAI 共同构建。

items.title: We’re sharing a new preprint showing wet lab validation of intrinsic protein design capabilities of the GPT-6 family of models. Our models can design new protein shapes and sequences using reasoning and code, without calling specialized biology models to generate them.
items.title_zh: 我们分享一份新的预印本，展示 GPT-6 系列模型内在蛋白质设计能力的湿实验室验证。我们的模型能够利用推理和代码设计新的蛋白质形状和序列，而无需调用专门的生物学模型来生成它们。

items.title: We recently migrated our Messages API from Python to Rust. On our engineering blog, we share how we used the existing service to verify the new one, with teams of Claude agents tracking down and fixing differences between the two versions.
items.title_zh: 我们最近将 Messages API 从 Python 迁移到了 Rust。在我们的工程博客上，我们分享了如何利用现有服务来验证新服务，由 Claude 智能体团队追踪并修复两个版本之间的差异。

items.title: New Anthropic Fellows research: Returning to the neuron basis for interpretability Understanding what’s happening inside an AI model helps to make it safer. One obvious place to look is its neurons, or the simple units it’s built from. Early interpretability work did just that,
items.title_zh: Anthropic Fellows 新研究：回归神经元基础以实现可解释性。理解 AI 模型内部发生的事情有助于使其更安全。一个显而易见的地方是它的神经元，即构成它的简单单元。早期的可解释性工作正是这样做的……

items.title: MedChemBench is a new benchmark for AI reasoning in medicinal chemistry. It shows the progress our frontier models have made in their ability to help scientists use AI to identify promising drug candidates.
items.title_zh: MedChemBench 是一个用于药物化学中 AI 推理的新基准。它展示了我们的前沿模型在帮助科学家利用 AI 识别有前景的候选药物方面所取得的进展。

items.title: Quantum computers could one day transform fusion energy, chemistry, and drug discovery - if we can make the algorithms efficient enough to run on early hardware. Using teams of Gemini 4 agents, we’ve built new quantum circuits that cut future simulation costs by up to 10 times.
items.title_zh: 量子计算机有朝一日可能改变聚变能源、化学和药物发现——前提是我们能让算法足够高效，以便在早期硬件上运行。利用 Gemini 4 智能体团队，我们构建了新的量子电路，将未来的模拟成本降低多达 10 倍。
